```{r}
#| include: false
# Built by `Rscript gr.R catalog --html` from the tables in this folder; do not edit the HTML.
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("GR_ROOT", unset = normalizePath("..", winslash = "/")), "R", "load.R"))
subj <- subjects()
st <- metric_status()
doc <- metrics_doc()
src <- source_status()
geo <- geo_support()
lists <- function(x) gsub(";", ", ", x, fixed = TRUE)
table_md <- function(df) knitr::kable(df, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE)
```

This catalog lists `r nrow(doc)` metrics in `r length(unique(subj$subject_id))` subjects and
`r nrow(subj)` subtopics, drawn from `r nrow(src)` public data sources. Each metric has one of
three statuses, kept separate on purpose:

- **Operational** (`r sum(st$status == "operational")` metrics): a recipe (`recipes.csv`) and a
  data adapter exist, so the metric can be used in reports and is computed from the source.
- **Documented** (`r sum(st$status == "documented")`): the source's documentation was read and
  verified (date and evidence below), but the project has no adapter for it yet. These metrics
  cannot be selected in a report.
- **Candidate** (`r sum(st$status == "candidate")`): the documentation is not yet verified.

Whether a sample of the data was actually retrieved is tracked separately for each source
(`sample_status`), and `gr.R verify` appends live checks of the operational sources to
`verification_log.csv`. A source existing does not mean it covers every place or year: the
geography levels and years listed are those the source publishes, and each report lists the
values it could not show for its own areas and periods.

## Scope and known gaps

The inventory covers the subjects in the project brief, from federal statistical programs
(Census Bureau, BLS, BEA, HHS, HUD, USDA, EPA, FCC, NCES, FBI and others), a few state
administrative sources for child care, and national nonprofit compilations. It is a declared
inventory, not a claim to cover every public dataset. Documentation was checked on 2026-09-28.

Known gaps and cautions:

- **Child care.** No open national file of licensed facilities and capacity was found; capacity
  comes from state licensing systems (Texas and Indiana are implemented; New York, California,
  Colorado, Washington and Missouri are documented). There are no county data on child care
  enrollment or use. Capacity is a regulatory maximum that includes school-age slots, not
  enrollment, and state rules differ, so ratios should not be compared across states. NDCP
  prices have no data for Indiana or New Mexico and gaps in other states. Preschool enrollment
  is not a measure of child care availability.
- **Access limits.** Some sources need registration or agreements (e.g. FBI and ICPSR crime
  files, election returns behind a guestbook, the FCC broadband API); several agency sites
  reject scripted requests. These are cataloged with their access requirements.
- **Discontinued or changed products.** EPA EJScreen was withdrawn in 2025 (archived copies
  only); FEMA's National Risk Index changed its inputs; NFIRS ends in 2026; FCC broadband
  data broke between Form 477 and the Broadband Data Collection; USDA ended its household
  food security reports in 2025.
- **Breaks to respect in trends.** Connecticut's planning regions replaced counties in 2022
  (sources switch in different years); race and ethnicity coding changed in 2020; LAUS
  substate series break between 2009 and 2010; County Business Patterns moved from SIC to
  NAICS in 1998; October 2025 is missing from LAUS, CPS and CPI because of the federal shutdown.
- **Not yet cataloged or verified.** CPS ASEC and the Supplemental Poverty Measure, SNAP
  administrative data, WIC and school meals, Medicaid enrollment, HRSA UDS patient counts, a
  crosswalk from homelessness Continuums of Care to counties, and 1990s county intercensal
  estimates. The Census Data API has no 1990 census tables; city population histories from
  1970 to 2000 come from IPUMS NHGIS (which needs `IPUMS_API_KEY`).

## Subjects

```{r}
#| results: asis
x <- merge(st, doc[, c("metric_id", "subtopic_id")], by = "metric_id")
counts <- aggregate(cbind(metrics = 1, operational = x$status == "operational"),
                    by = list(subject_id = x$subject_id, subtopic_id = x$subtopic_id), FUN = sum)
by_sub <- merge(subj, counts, by = c("subject_id", "subtopic_id"), all.x = TRUE)
by_sub$metrics[is.na(by_sub$metrics)] <- 0
by_sub$operational[is.na(by_sub$operational)] <- 0
by_sub <- by_sub[order(by_sub$subject, by_sub$subtopic), ]
table_md(data.frame(Subject = by_sub$subject, Subtopic = by_sub$subtopic, Metrics = by_sub$metrics,
                    Operational = by_sub$operational, Description = by_sub$description))
```

## Metrics

```{r}
#| results: asis
m <- merge(doc, st[, c("metric_id", "status")], by = "metric_id")
m <- merge(m, unique(subj[, c("subject_id", "subject", "subtopic_id", "subtopic")]), by = c("subject_id", "subtopic_id"))
m$source <- src$name[match(m$source_id, src$source_id)]
for (s in sort(unique(m$subject))) {
  x <- m[m$subject == s, , drop = FALSE]
  x <- x[order(x$subtopic, x$status != "operational", x$label), ]
  cat("\n### ", s, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(table_md(data.frame(Subtopic = x$subtopic, Metric = x$label, Status = x$status, Source = x$source,
                          Geographies = lists(x$geo_levels), Periods = x$periods,
                          `Comparable span` = x$comparable_span, Breaks = x$breaks,
                          Limitations = x$limitations, check.names = FALSE)), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Sources

```{r}
#| results: asis
src <- src[order(src$agency, src$name), ]
table_md(data.frame(Source = paste0("[", src$name, "](", src$doc_url, ")"), Agency = src$agency,
                    Access = src$access_requirements,
                    Documentation = paste(src$doc_status, src$doc_checked),
                    `Sample retrieval` = paste(src$sample_status, src$sample_checked),
                    Adapter = src$adapter, `Time coverage` = src$time_coverage, check.names = FALSE))
```

## Geography support

```{r}
#| results: asis
table_md(data.frame(Type = geo$label, ID = geo$geoid_format, `Study area` = geo$study_area,
                    `Union member` = geo$union_member, Benchmark = geo$benchmark, Status = geo$status,
                    Relationships = geo$relationships, Notes = geo$notes, check.names = FALSE))
```

## Verification log

```{r}
#| results: asis
log_path <- root_path("catalog", "verification_log.csv")
if (file.exists(log_path)) {
  log <- read_table(log_path)
  log <- log[order(log$date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  log <- log[!duplicated(log$source_id), ]
  table_md(data.frame(Source = log$source_id, Checked = log$date, Result = log$result, Evidence = log$evidence))
} else {
  cat("No live checks recorded yet. Run `Rscript gr.R verify`.")
}
```
